description: This file defines the class ImapHandlerFakeData, which is a test utility for mocking IMAP handler responses in the SuiteCRM project. It provides methods to manage and simulate fake IMAP call data for testing purposes.

classes.name: ImapHandlerFakeData
classes.description: A class used for mocking IMAP handler calls and responses for testing within the SuiteCRM project.

methods.name: encodeArgs
methods.description: Encodes method arguments into a md5 hash for use as a key.

methods.name: getNextCallReturn
methods.description: Retrieves the next return value for a given call based on method name and encoded arguments.

methods.name: getCall
methods.description: Fetches a pre-defined call response based on method name and arguments.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Executes a fake call, returning the predefined response.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a fake call and its response to the mock data store.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specific fake call configuration.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets or replaces a fake call with the specified response.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Preloads fake call responses from a provided array, used for setting up test scenarios.
